prices.name: Resurface (machine) brake rotors (one axle)
prices.includes: Machining both rotors on one axle at a shop that removes and refits them; some shops include it with a pad job. A rotor below its minimum thickness must be replaced instead (typical = middle of the $80-$120 shop price)

sources.title: How Much Does Resurfacing Brake Rotors Cost?
sources.quote: If a repair shop must remove, machine, inspect, and reinstall the rotors, a practical budget is about $100 to $200+ per axle.

sources.title: Brake Lathe vs Rotor Replacement: 2026 Cost Analysis for Auto Shops - Best Buy Automotive Equipment
sources.quote: Customer pricing shows an even starker contrast: $300-$600 per axle for pad and rotor replacement versus $80-$120 for resurfacing service.

sources.title: Should I Replace or Resurface My Car's Brake Rotors?
sources.quote: The average cost for resurfacing brake rotors is between $20 to $40 for each brake rotor. If the shop is already performing a brake pad replacement, this might be included in the service.

prices.name: Brake fluid flush (exchange)
prices.includes: Old brake fluid drained and the system bled with new fluid; independent shops about $110-$160, dealers $140-$220; usually due every 2-3 years (typical = independent-shop midpoint)

sources.title: How Much Does a Brake Fluid Replacement Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: For most drivers, a standard brake fluid flush with a full system bleed lands around $110–$160 at independent shops and $140–$220 at dealerships.

sources.title: Why Are Brake Fluid Changes Important? | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: For the most part, you can expect a brake fluid change to cost somewhere between $80 and $200.

sources.title: Why You Need a Brake Fluid Flush And What It Costs
sources.quote: The average brake fluid flush cost is typically $75 to $250. The price includes both parts and labor.

prices.name: Shop supplies fee (per repair order)
prices.includes: Rags, cleaners and other consumables. Usually 5-10% of labor capped around $30-$50, or a flat $15-$35; about $5-$15 on an oil change. In California a generic "shop supplies" line is not allowed: the supplies used must be itemized (typical = middle of the flat fee)

sources.title: Shop Supplies Charge: The $46,000 Line Item — WickedFile
sources.quote: The most common industry convention is a percentage of the labor total, commonly 5% to 10%, with a per-ticket cap somewhere around $30 to $50.

sources.title: How Much Does an Oil Change Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: Shop supplies and oil disposal typically add $5–$15

sources.title: Write It Right: Documentation and authorization requirements for automotive repair dealers - Bureau of Automotive Repair
sources.quote: Separate billing in an invoice for items generically noted as shop supplies, miscellaneous parts, fees for electronic communication with the Smog Check database, and the like, is prohibited. (CCR § 3356(g))

prices.name: Coolant flush (cooling system / radiator flush)
prices.includes: Old coolant drained or machine-flushed and refilled; a basic drain-and-fill $80-$150, dealers and luxury models at the high end (typical = middle of the most-shops price)

sources.title: How Much Does a Cooling System Flush Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: the average cooling system flush price (also called a coolant flush or radiator flush) runs $173–$184 at most shops. A basic drain-and-fill (no machine flush) often costs $80–$150

sources.title: Cost of a Radiator Flush - Car Repair and Maintenance - CostHelper
sources.quote: Expect to pay $40-$200 to have a radiator flushed, depending on the age, make and model of the vehicle

sources.title: Top 10 Affordable Car Repairs | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: Price Range: $30-60 for DIY supplies; $265-$402 for professional flush and fill

prices.name: Transmission fluid service (drain and fill or flush)
prices.includes: Automatic transmission fluid drained or exchanged and refilled; a filter and gasket kit adds $40-$120, and a machine flush on some vehicles can reach $700 (typical = middle of a national quote average)

sources.title: How Much Does an Automatic Transmission Fluid Service Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: an automatic transmission fluid (ATF) service costs between $221–$264.

sources.title: Transmission Fluid Service Cost Estimate - Jerry
sources.quote: A transmission fluid flush costs between $100 to $700 while a transmission fluid change costs $80 to $400.

sources.title: How Much Does It Cost to Flush a Car Transmission
sources.quote: Expect to pay $75-$150 or more for a standard transmission fluid change.

prices.name: Replace the serpentine (drive) belt
prices.includes: The belt and up to about an hour of labor; a tensioner or idler pulley costs extra (typical = middle of a national quote range)

sources.title: How Much Does a Serpentine Belt Replacement Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: Jerry has helped over 40,000 customers across the U.S. get accurate repair prices and found that serpentine belt replacements cost between $121 – $174.

sources.title: Cost of Serpentine Belt Replacement - Car Repair and Maintenance - CostHelper
sources.quote: Hiring a mechanic to replace a serpentine belt typically costs about $60-$200 or more.

prices.name: Tire rotation
prices.includes: Moving all four tires to new positions; often free where the tires were bought, dealers $50-$90 (typical = middle of the $25-$60 most shops charge)

sources.title: How Much Does a Tire Rotation Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: Jerry has helped 40,000 customers find fair and accurate prices for their tire rotation needs — we’ve found that it typically costs $25–$60 at most shops.

sources.title: How Much Does Tire Rotation Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: The average cost of a tire rotation ranges from about $20 to $75, depending on your vehicle, tires, location and service provider.

sources.title: Top 10 Affordable Car Repairs | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: Price Range: $39-$60 for rotation only; $136-$196 for four-wheel alignment

prices.name: Diagnostic fee (check engine light testing)
prices.includes: Testing to find why the check engine light is on, not the repair itself; parts stores read codes free, and many shops credit the fee toward the repair (typical = midpoint of basic testing)

sources.title: When To Consult A Certified Mechanic | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: RepairPal estimates that basic check engine light testing and diagnosis cost $88 to $144.

sources.title: Common Symptoms of Failing Ignition Coils - Jerry
sources.quote: Expect a $120 to $200 diagnostic fee; ask for the scan report.

sources.title: "Check Engine" Tips On How To Handle It | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: National chains like Autozone can run a free diagnostic on your engine when the light comes on, typically costing up to $100 at a local mechanic.

prices.name: Replace the engine air filter
prices.includes: Filter and a few minutes of shop labor; dealers at the high end (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: How Much Does an Engine Air Filter Replacement Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: Jerry has helped 40,000 customers nationwide get reliable repair pricing and found most drivers pay $73 to $142 for an engine air filter replacement.

sources.title: Change Your Air Filters In Spring | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: the average cost for an air filter replacement on a Toyota Camry is between $47 and $56, while a Chevy Tahoe would be looking at a cost falling between $70 and $92.

prices.name: Power steering fluid flush
prices.includes: Old fluid in a hydraulic power steering system exchanged and bled, fluid and labor included (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: How Much Does Power Steering Fluid Flush Cost?
sources.quote: A power steering fluid flush typically costs $100 to $250 at a U.S. repair shop, including fluid and labor.

sources.title: Understanding and Resolving Power Steering Issues - Jerry
sources.quote: Flush with correct fluid & bleed ($120–$250)

prices.name: Replace windshield wiper blades (pair)
prices.includes: A pair of standard blades; parts stores often fit them free, others charge $20-$25. Beam, luxury or heated blades cost more (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: Cost of Windshield Wipers - Car Repair and Maintenance - CostHelper
sources.quote: A standard replacement blade assembly for the front windshield or a rear wiper on a hatchback or SUV typically costs $7-$20 each, or $14-$40 a pair

sources.title: Top 10 Affordable Car Repairs | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: Price Range: $20-$70 for DIY replacement; $53-$88 for professional installation
